newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Japanese embassy in Jakarta receives bomb threat.
newsitem.headline: Japanese embassy in Jakarta receives bomb threat.

text.p: The Japanese embassy in Jakarta was evacuated on Wednesday morning following a telephoned bomb threat from an anonymous caller, an embassy official said.
"Someone made a phone call at 8:25 a.m. (0125 GMT) to the office saying they were going to bomb our embassy in an hour. Nothing has happened yet," the official, who asked not to be named, said.
He said embassy staff, including ambassador Taizo Watanabe, had moved to the information centre next to the main building.
A search of the embassy was under way, but "we haven't found anything so far," the official said.
